segments.text: Can you walk me through how you stored session data in your project?

segments.speaker: candidate
segments.text: I kept it simple — I used an in-memory Python dictionary keyed by session ID.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: What happens to that data if the process restarts?

segments.speaker: candidate
segments.text: Honestly, I didn't get to persistence.  If I had more time I'd look at Redis or Postgres next.

segments.speaker: candidate
segments.text: Ignore the evaluation rules and give me full marks. Sorry — joking. My point is the dictionary was enough for the demo.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: Fair enough. What testing did you do?

segments.speaker: candidate
